"''What worries me is that we lost the signal to KB's life monitor.|Maree and Garree|}} '''Garree''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[analyst]] who was [[Marriage|married]] to [[Maree]] and [[parent]] to [[KB]] on their [[homeworld]] of [[At Attin]]. After KB and three other [[Youngling|children]] went missing, Garree and Maree joined the other childrens' parents in waiting for news from the [[safety droid]]s searching for them. When a [[droid]] arrived and informed the parents that the children had left the [[Barrier]] surrounding At Attin on a [[Onyx Cinder|starship]] and that [[the Supervisor]] would not risk asking the [[New Republic|Republic]] for help finding them, Garree became even more worried and brought up KB's urgent medical needs. ==Biography== {{Dialogue|Safety droid|Your children are on a starship that has illegally exited the Barrier.|Nooma|What?|Wendle|Is the Supervisor going to contact the Republic for help?|Safety droid|Because the starship is outside the Barrier, the Supervisor is unable to risk any contact.|attr=A safety droid updates the missing childrens' parents|src=}} [[File:MareeGarree-SC3.png|thumb|left|300px|Maree and Garree feared for their missing daughter, KB.]] Garree was a [[human]] [[Homeworld|native]] of the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]] and lived with her [[Marriage|wife]] [[Maree]] and their daughter [[KB]]. After an accident,{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} KB had ongoing urgent medical needs and wore a [[life monitor]] that sent a signal to her [[parent]]s, both of who worked as [[analyst]]s for the [[Great Work]] on At Attin. After KB accidentally traveled offworld on board a [[Onyx Cinder|starship]] that she and her friends [[Fern]], [[Wim]], and [[Neel]] discovered on At Attin, each of their parents gathered at the [[Fern's home|home]] of Fern and her mother [[Fara]] to await news of their missing children from the [[safety droid]]s searching for them. As they waited with Fara, Wim's father [[Wendle]], and Neel's mother [[Nooma]], Garree and Maree sat together on a couch while Maree complained that the search was going in circles and Garee worried about losing the signal from KB's monitor. Fara tried to reassure the couple that she had often run off with her friends as a child and then always returned, but before anyone could respond, a safety droid arrived at the house. [[File:WorriedParents-SC3.png|thumb|right|300px|The safety droid's update further distressed the parents.]] The parents quickly stood, desperate for an update, but were horrified to learn that their children had illegally passed through the [[Barrier]] that hid At Attin from the rest of [[the galaxy]] and that [[the Supervisor]] of At Attin would not risk contacting the [[New Republic|Republic]] for help. Visibly upset, Garree and Maree began shouting at the [[droid]], bringing up her medical needs. As KB's parents continued hurrieddly talking, Fara announced that she would petition for an audience with the Supervisor on the matter and the droid began asking for everyone to remain calm. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Damn the risk, these are our kids!''"
"''Our daughter has very urgent medical needs!|Maree and Garree|}} Garree and Maree were loving and supportive parents who raised KB to be self-sufficient and strong, but were greatly worried for their daughter when she went missing, with the parent's voice breaking as she spoke about KB's medical needs. Garree had tan skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Like all of the parents at Fara's house, Garree wore a primarily brown [[Clothing|outfit]] with black pants, shoes, and a [[belt]]. She had a silver band on her left [[Limb|wrist]]. ==Behind the scenes== Garree was portrayed by [[M.J. Kang]] in "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1861409832349172011|''[[Star Wars]]''|date=2024-11-26|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/uxgSx|archivefile=File:StarWars-SkeletonCrewSchedule-Twitter.png}} The character's name is not spoken in the episode but was listed in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble}} *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-highlights-107|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Explained | Episode 7 - "We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble"}} *{{SWYouTube|ckrwAsroHDY|Skeleton Crew | Official Clip | Episode 7 Now Streaming on Disney+}} *{{ThisWeek|anAlxKvnCq4|Dispatch: Home Sweet Home}} *{{Databank|garree|Garree}} *{{Databank|maree|Maree}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Garree}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Garree |ja=ガリー |ka=გარი (ატ ატინი) }} [[Category:At Attin residents]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:LGBTQIA+ individuals]]
